source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 11.6.2 (Preparation of Alkenes), printed pages 255-256.

blocks.text: Alkenes saturated compounds ke sath wale (adjacent) carbon atoms se chhote atoms (H, OH, X) hata kar banaye jate hain taake carbon atoms ke darmiyan double bond bane; yeh elimination reactions hain, jin mein organic molecule ke sath wale carbons se H2O ya HCl jaisa chhota molecule hataya jata hai. Ethene yun banai jati hai.

Ethene ethanol aur zyada ghaliz sulfuric acid ke mixture ko 180 degrees C par garam kar ke banai jati hai; alcohol se pani ka molecule hataya jata hai: CH3CH2OH H2SO4 aur garmi ke saath CH2=CH2 + H2O deta hai. Pehle qadam mein ethyl hydrogen sulfate banta hai, CH3CH2OH + H2SO4 se CH3CH2OSO3H + H2O, aur yeh garam hone par toot kar ethene deta hai: CH3CH2OSO3H se CH2=CH2 + H2SO4.

Ethyl bromide ko alcoholic KOH ke saath garam karne par ethene banti hai; sath wale carbons se hydrogen aur halogen hat kar double bond banate hain: CH3CH2Br + KOH (alcoholic) garmi ke saath CH2=CH2 + KBr + H2O deta hai.

blocks.prompt: Propanol ke H2SO4 ke saath reactions aur bromopropane ki dehydrohalogenation dein (Quick Check 11.4a, d, e).
blocks.explanation: Propan-1-ol ghaliz sulfuric acid ke saath pehle propyl hydrogen sulfate banata hai, CH3CH2CH2OH + H2SO4 se CH3CH2CH2OSO3H + H2O, jo garam hone par acid kho kar propene deta hai, CH3CH=CH2 + H2SO4; kul mila kar dehydration. 1-Bromopropane garam alcoholic KOH ke saath sath wale carbons se HBr khota hai: CH3CH2CH2Br + KOH se CH3CH=CH2 + KBr + H2O.

items: Elimination sath wale carbons se chhota molecule (H2O, HX) hata kar C=C banata hai. Ethene: ethanol + ghaliz H2SO4 180 degrees C par (ethyl hydrogen sulfate ke zariye); bromoethane + alcoholic KOH, garmi.
